description: Edit a SceneGraph node on the running dev channel at runtime by setting one or more fields. Uses the roku-test-automation (RTA) On-Device Component on TCP port 9000 — the same backend the SceneGraph Inspector in the vscode-brightscript-language extension uses. Requires RTA to be present in the running channel (see README "Runtime UI Editing"). nodeId can be either a `uiElementId` like "RTA_1773" (as shown by roku_query_sg_nodes) or a BrightScript scene-level `id`. Common fields: visible (boolean), translation ([x,y]), text (string), color (hex like "0xRRGGBBAA"), opacity (number 0..1).

fields.description: Map of field name -> new value. Each field becomes one setValue request.

host.description: IP address or hostname of the Roku device

nodeId.description: uiElementId (e.g. "RTA_1773") or BrightScript scene id of the node to edit

name: roku_edit_node
